headword: {市場投入|しじょうとうにゅう}

definitions.gloss: market launch; market introduction; bringing to market
definitions.explanation: The act of introducing a new product or service into the marketplace. A standard business term used in product development, marketing, and corporate communications.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新製品|しんせいひん}→新製品：18629_shinseihin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{市場投入|しじょうとうにゅう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{来年|らいねん}→来年：00745_rainen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{予定|よてい}→予定：00824_yotei⟧だ。
examples.english: The market launch of the new product is planned for next year.

examples.japanese: ⟦{競合他社|きょうごうたしゃ}→競合他社：25602_kyougoutasha⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦{早|はや}く→早い：00514_hayai⟧{市場投入|しじょうとうにゅう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{重要|じゅうよう}→重要：01575_juuyou⟧だ。
examples.english: It is important to bring it to market faster than the competitors.

examples.japanese: ⟦{開発|かいはつ}→開発：06746_kaihatsu⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{市場投入|しじょうとうにゅう}⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{期間|きかん}→期間：00229_kikan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{短縮|たんしゅく}する→短縮する：26835_tanshukusuru⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{生産|せいさん}→生産：01444_seisan⟧ライン⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{導入|どうにゅう}した→導入する：16055_dounyuusuru⟧。
examples.english: To shorten the time from development to market launch, a new production line was introduced.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{市場|しじょう}→市場：09685_shijou⟧ (market) and ⟦{投入|とうにゅう}→投入：12895_tounyuu⟧ (putting in, investment). Commonly used in business news, press releases, and corporate strategy discussions. Can also be used as a verb with ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧.

Note that ⟦{市場|しじょう}→市場：09685_shijou⟧ in this context is read しじょう (market in the business/economic sense), not いちば (physical marketplace).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {市場投入|しじょうとうにゅう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to launch on the market
- {市場投入|しじょうとうにゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{時期|じき}→時期：03269_jiki⟧: timing of the market launch
- {市場投入|しじょうとうにゅう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{急|いそ}ぐ→急ぐ：01191_isogu⟧: to rush the market launch
- {市場投入|しじょうとうにゅう}⟦{後|ご}→後：30157_go⟧: after market introduction

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{発売|はつばい}→発売：04315_hatsubai⟧: release, going on sale — more commonly used for consumer products
- {上市|じょうし}: market listing, launch — more formal, used in pharmaceutical and financial contexts
- ⟦{商品化|しょうひんか}→商品化：30135_shouhinka⟧: commercialization — the broader process of turning something into a product
